_comment: Confusable sibling-tag groups for the ASL sibling-gap telemetry (todos/ASL_plan.md SS5). The metric only uses validation samples with EXACTLY ONE labeled tag per group (score of the labeled sibling minus max score among unlabeled siblings), so multi-membership (multicolored_hair, heterochromia, gradient_hair) never corrupts it and colors are NOT treated as exclusive. Tags missing from the vocabulary are skipped with a debug log. A penis_type group {horse_penis, dog_penis, knotted_penis, penis_tentacle} was evaluated 2026-08-10 and REJECTED: ~15 eligible samples per ~30K eval (vs 1e3-1e5 for the groups here) would enter sibling_gap_macro at full 1/N weight (no min-n gate exists) and inject order-of-magnitude jitter into the stop arbiter; dog/knotted co-occur 85% (feature, not sibling). Do not add without a min-n gate in asl_telemetry (gap_cnts floor ~200) plus ~10x corpus growth.
